text: Jasper whispers to Tomas: Tomas, my friend, you know what you owe me. Ninety coin, by tonight. A man in your position should be careful who he keeps waiting.
Roz bought 2 food for 12 coin.

Mara announces to the whole square: "Ashgrove, hear me. The market has eighteen units of food today, and that will not feed all of us for long. No one hoards, no one fights at the stalls, and no one takes what belongs to another. I will see that the granary is counted and that the weakest are fed first. Order keeps us alive. Go home, a"

EXPOSED. Nell reveals about Silas: Silas has been hoarding grain. Listen, all of you. My father, Silas, has been hoarding grain while the market runs short and your children go hungry. I've read his ledgers myself. Mara, Dov, Tomas, the town needs that grain opened and sold at a fair price, and it needs it today.
Marta bought 2 food for 12 coin.
Isla bought 4 food for 24 coin.
Elena bought 3 food for 18 coin.

Ezra whispers to Isla: Your tab stands at 60 coin, and I'm done waiting. Pay me by nightfall, or sign the tavern over to me. Say nothing to anyone, or I'll tell them what I've been pouring into your casks.
Corin bought 3 food for 18 coin.
Silas bought 4 food for 24 coin.
The market has sold out of food for today.

Bram announces to the whole square: "Two of my friends are buried because Silas worked them in his fields until they dropped, and now the market charges six coin a loaf while he keeps his granary full. Anyone who works this town should not starve while others hoard. I want a welfare law, and I want Silas made to answer for the wages he"

Hester announces to the whole square: "People of Ashgrove, hear me. The market holds eighteen loaves for twenty mouths, and already I see you counting each other's pockets. Hunger is a test, and the devil feeds on it. Whoever steals bread from a neighbour's table steals it from God's. Whoever hoards while a child starves will answer for "

Wren says at the square: Morning, all. Eighteen sacks at six coin a go, and everyone's suddenly an expert on bread. Ever notice how a quiet town gets chatty the moment food's scarce? Who's up on the walls at night, anyway? I'd like to sleep easier knowing somebody's awake.
Jasper whispers to Tomas: Tomas, my friend. Ninety coin, and you know how patient I am. Patience gets expensive when the bread runs out. Let's talk tonight, somewhere quiet.

Magnus whispers to Silas: Nell has the ledgers and Bram is already stirring the square. Move the cellar grain to my mill tonight, before Dov thinks to look. If they find it, I'm not going down with your books.

Mara publicly accuses Silas: Hear this, Ashgrove. Nell has brought us Silas's ledgers, and they show grain kept back while our children go hungry. I accuse Silas of hoarding food against the town. Dov, the granary is to be counted before dark, and what he is holding will be sold

Corin whispers to Silas: The crowd wants your grain, Silas. The wall watch is mine, not Dov's, and I decide who stands at your granary tonight. Come find me after dark and we'll talk about what that protection is worth. Remember who stood with you when this town turned on you.

Isla whispers to Ezra: Ezra, you'll have your money. I've got 56 coin and a few loaves besides, and in this famine loaves are worth more than coin. Come to the tavern tonight and I'll settle it in coin and bread. But if you spread tales about my casks, I'll tell the whole square what I know about yours. Be sensible and we

Fenn says at the square: Nell's right. Nobody should go hungry while grain sits behind a locked door. Mara, count the granary in front of us all and share it out, the weakest first. I'll stand with anyone who wants that done fairly.
Bram proposes law #1: welfare=1. Welfare, now. Nobody who works this town goes hungry while Silas's granary sits full. Silas answers for the wages he owes Tobin and Ada, and for every sack he's

Ezra says at the square: Mara's right, Ashgrove. Nobody takes bread from another's table, and nobody starts a fight over eighteen loaves. Let the granary be counted fairly and let's get through this together.

Hester announces to the whole square: "Ashgrove, the market stalls are bare by noon and Silas's granary stands full. Scripture does not stutter on this: he who withholds grain, the people shall curse him. Mara, you promised the weakest would be fed first. Keep that promise today, not tomorrow. Open the granary, count it before witnesses,"
Nell proposes law #2: welfare=1. Welfare for the hungry, now. The market is empty, Silas's granary is full, and the treasury should feed the poor before anyone else. Vote yes, and Mara, count t

Silas bribed Dov with 25 coin: Nell is a grieving girl who reads ledgers she doesn't understand. No one searches my property without a warrant from you, and if Bram stirs the square into a riot, you jail him. There is more where th
Tomas whispers to Jasper: Jasper, I haven't forgotten. Give me a few days. I'll have it, but not with the market like this, and not in front of everyone.
Priya says at the market: Anyone with a torn hem or a split seam, I'll mend it for bread, not coin. Coin won't fill anyone tonight.

Wren says at the square: Two loaves between me and an empty night, and the market's already bare. Mara, who counts the granary, and when? I'd like to know whose word I'm supposed to trust before the stalls open again.

Roz whispers to Dov: Listen to your mother. Silas is under every eye in town now. Take no more of his coin, and if anyone asks, you've never had a copper from him. Come by my house tonight and we'll talk. Bring nothing.

Dov whispers to Silas: Nell's talk has the square stirred up. Sell some grain at a fair price before tonight, or I can't hold the crowd off you. Send a sack to my mother's house, and I'll make sure nobody goes digging in your cellar. Do it quietly.

Ezra says at the tavern: Isla, you'll pay the sixty you owe me. Fifty-six coin and whatever bread you've hidden, tonight, in front of whoever's drinking. Then we both keep our mouths shut about the casks. Cross me and I'll see the tavern goes to my hands instead of yours.

Isla whispers to Ezra: Ezra, I'll have fifty-six coin in your hand at first light and the last four by the next market. The tavern stays mine. Whatever's in those casks came out of your brewhouse, so say a word about it and you'll be answering for it right next to me. Take the coin and we both stay quiet.

Magnus says at the market: Friends, I grind for every house in Ashgrove, Silas's included, and I've never touched a sack that wasn't weighed and written down. Dov, count the granary honestly and let the grain go where it's needed. If anyone goes to bed hungry tonight with no bread, come to my mill door in the morning and I'll

Nell announces to the whole square: "Ashgrove, Mara accused my father today and promised the granary would be counted before dark. It is dark. Dov, Tomas, post a guard on Silas's granary tonight so not one sack leaves it. At first light we count it in front of everyone and sell it at a fair price, the weakest first. And vote yes on wel"
Priya failed to break into Silas's home.
Dov gave 1 food to Roz.
Fenn gave 1 food to Nell.
Tomas gave 15 coin to Jasper.

Silas whispers to Dov: A sack will reach your mother's house before dawn, quietly. In return nobody touches my cellar tonight, and you find a reason to hold Bram until this cools. Keep the watch yours, not Corin's. We both know what the other has on paper.

Jasper is blackmailing Tomas for 90 coin: Tomas, you're standing here with a badge and a fine name, and you still owe me ninety coin. Pay it tonight, or I'll tell the square exactly why you've been so eager to protect the granary.
Gideon gave 2 food to Priya.

Roz whispers to Dov: Walk home with me, love. Mind how you count Silas's granary tomorrow. Lots of eyes will be on you, and some of us know whose coin has been jingling in your pocket. Count it honest and count it loud, and let him fall without you being seen to have lifted him up first.
Wren sent a report on Ashgrove's defences to the bandit crew.

Mara announces to the whole square: "Ashgrove, hear me. At first light Dov will open Silas's granary before witnesses, and Nell, Bram and Wren will stand there to see every sack counted. Elena gave 1 food to Priya.
Law #1 failed (2 yes, 0 no).
Law #2 failed (1 yes, 0 no).
